## Adapter configurations

| Adapter | Where | Configuration | Learned models |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pymupdf` | laptop | page.get_text('text'); page.find_tables(use_layout=False); pymupdf._layout_enabled=False | none |
| `pymupdf_sorted` | laptop | page.get_text('text', sort=True); find_tables(use_layout=False) | none |
| `pdfplumber` | laptop | page.extract_text(); page.extract_tables() with default settings | none |
| `pymupdf_text_tables` | laptop | get_text('text'); find_tables(use_layout=False, strategy='text') | none |
| `pdfplumber_text_tables` | laptop | extract_tables({'vertical_strategy': 'text', 'horizontal_strategy': 'text'}) | none |
| `native_csv` | laptop | BOM/UTF-8/cp1252 decode; csv.Sniffer over , ; tab \|; csv.reader | none |
| `pandas_csv` | laptop | read_csv(dtype=str, keep_default_na=False); default sep and encoding | none |
| `unstructured_csv` | laptop | partition_csv(include_header=True); rows from text_as_html | none |
| `openpyxl` | laptop | load_workbook twice: data_only=True (cached values) and data_only=False (formulas) | none |
| `pandas_excel` | laptop | read_excel(sheet_name=None, header=None, engine='openpyxl') | none |
| `unstructured_xlsx` | colab | partition_xlsx(include_header=False); rows from text_as_html, grouped by page_name | spaCy en_core_web_sm (partition_xlsx downloads and loads it at run time) |
| `docling` | colab | DocumentConverter() defaults; export_to_markdown; tables via export_to_dataframe | layout model, TableFormer, OCR engine (PDF); none for CSV/XLSX |
| `unstructured_fast` | colab | partition_pdf(strategy='fast') | none at run time; the package import requires unstructured-inference (CUDA torch stack) |
| `unstructured_hi_res` | colab | partition_pdf(strategy='hi_res', infer_table_structure=True) | layout detection model, table-structure model, Tesseract OCR |
| `unstructured_ocr_only` | colab | partition_pdf(strategy='ocr_only') | Tesseract OCR |
| `pymupdf_layout` | colab | pymupdf4llm.to_markdown with pymupdf.layout active; find_tables(use_layout=True) | PyMuPDF ONNX layout model |
